newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 7.35 percent at Italy dollar repo.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 7.35 percent at Italy dollar repo.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's $4.0 billion Bank of Italy one-month repurchase tender was 7.35 percent against 7.41 percent at the previous one-month tender.
The average indicative rate was 7.37 percent from 7.44 percent at the last foreign currency-denominated repo for 3.0 billion marks on February 13.

The Bank said the tender was fully subscribed and the funds assigned at a minimum 2.55 forward points above the 1,667.50 lire per dollar floor set by the Bank of Italy. The Bank received 27 bids of which six were met in full and nine in part.
